title: Thermostat Hysteresis Room Heating
description: Thermal room heating plant coupled to a reusable ESL SUBMODEL controller with deadband hysteresis switching via WHEN discontinuity events.
code:
-- ESA ESL Thermostat-Controlled Room Heating with Hysteresis Submodel
STUDY RoomHeatingStudy
  SUBMODEL HeaterPower(IN REAL: cmd; IN REAL: p_max; OUT REAL: q_heat)
  DYNAMIC
    q_heat = cmd * p_max;
  END SUBMODEL HeaterPower

  MODEL ThermalRoom
    CONSTANT REAL: C_TH = 18000.0;  -- Room thermal capacitance (J/K)
    CONSTANT REAL: G_LOSS = 45.0;   -- Wall conductance (W/K)
    CONSTANT REAL: T_AMB = 5.0;     -- Outdoor temperature (C)
    CONSTANT REAL: P_MAX = 2500.0;  -- Heater rated power (W)
    CONSTANT REAL: T_LOW = 19.5;    -- Lower hysteresis threshold (C)
    CONSTANT REAL: T_HIGH = 21.5;   -- Upper hysteresis threshold (C)
    REAL: temp, q_heat, heater_cmd;
  INITIAL
    temp = 16.0;
    heater_cmd = 1.0;
  DYNAMIC
    HeaterPower(heater_cmd, P_MAX, q_heat);
    temp' = (q_heat - G_LOSS * (temp - T_AMB)) / C_TH;
    WHEN temp >= T_HIGH THEN
      heater_cmd := 0.0;
    END_WHEN
    WHEN temp <= T_LOW THEN
      heater_cmd := 1.0;
    END_WHEN
  END MODEL ThermalRoom
END STUDY RoomHeatingStudy
